change: Centralize Team phase execution, prepared rework and validated retry state transitions in a pure reducer.
invariants: only attempt admission advances durable run-wide counters
progress updates are fenced by epoch and attempt
phase projection preserves durable attempts and succeeded records
rework owner validation and retry status/activity gates remain before reducer entry
rework/retry invalidate stale validation receipts while retaining unaffected successful siblings

validation.details: 8 core unit tests and 1 integration test

limits: Team phase runner state is still projected into durable state.
Steer/replace/cancel are not yet routed through one scheduler authority.
No real-model Single-versus-Team paired evaluation was run.
